subject: AWS Marketplace listing: localized claims, procurement questions & co-sell objections
messages:
From: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acme-inc.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing: localized claims & procurement Qs

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the convo yesterday. We're getting close to the AWS Marketplace submission window and I wanted to loop you in on a couple things procurement flagged before we go live:

• Local market claims — legal wants tighter language for EU/UK versus US hero lines (no absolute "guarantees" around latency).
• Data retention & auditability — procurement asked whether Redwood can commit to 12 months of request-level audit logs and an SOC2 evidence package during onboarding.

I've attached our standard RFI (acme_rfi_2026.pdf). Can you and your team share a brief note on the proposed hero/description edits and whether the listing can surface the audit/audit-log guarantees for customers?

Also happy to set up a quick 30-min readout with your field/sales ops if that helps.

Cheers,
Jamie
Jamie Lee
Director, Cloud Platforms — Acme Inc.
Attachments: acme_rfi_2026.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: localized claims & procurement Qs

Jamie — thanks for the RFI and the flags. Quick summary of next steps from our side and what we can commit to in the listing: 

1) Hero/description language: we can provide region-aware hero variants that avoid hard guarantees (e.g., "low-latency inference at production scale" -> US: callout to our West/US latency profiles; EU/UK: "latency varies by region; see SLA bucket"). I'll draft two hero variants and post to a shared doc.

2) Auditability/data retention: we can confirm 12-month request-level logs for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted customers get configurable retention via the Console (we'll add an explanatory footnote). SOC 2 evidence: we can provide the SOC 2 listing blurb and an onboarding evidence package link in the listing assets.

3) Co-sell objections: Marissa and Kim will help us shape two short objection-handling bullets for sellers (pricing/perf tradeoffs; private deployment path).

I've dropped a first-pass draft into the linked Google Doc and attached a markdown excerpt (redwood_listing_draft.md). Can we lock a 30-min slot Mon 11/2 at 10am PT to go through procurement redlines?

Best,
Alex
Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_listing_draft.md

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: localized claims & procurement Qs

Alex / Marissa — quick editorial and legal-safety notes on the draft: 

• Hero: change "guaranteed" -> "designed for"; add parenthetical "(latency varies by region and model size)" for EU/UK copy.
• Footnote for SOC2: add "SOC 2 Type II in scope for hosted and dedicated offerings; evidence available upon SaaS onboarding".
• Procurement line: offer Private deployment as an option for regulated data with "customer-managed KMS/HSM" callout.

Also: recommend adding a short FAQ entry in the listing around "what data is retained and how to request audit logs" — this reduces procurement friction.

Putting these into the doc now.

—Kimberly
Legal & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acme-inc.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Inc. Procurement <procurement@acme-inc.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: localized claims & procurement Qs

Thanks Alex — the timing works. A couple of follow-ups after reviewing your doc: 

1) Procurement attached redlines to our vendor terms (redlines_vendor_terms.docx). We need to confirm indemnity limits and a clause around subcontractor data handling (AWS Marketplace requires clarity here).
2) Is the 12-month audit log retention a hard commit for a Marketplace listing blurb or is that only part of the onboarding contract? Our compliance team prefers it be explicit in the listing so pre-sales can sign off.

If you can point us to the proposed final hero/footnote by EOD Tue (11/3) we can circulate internally and sign off faster.

Thanks —
Jamie
Attachments: redlines_vendor_terms.docx

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: localized claims & procurement Qs

Jamie — appreciate the quick turnaround. I reviewed the procurement redlines and looped in Legal. Short answers: 

• Indemnity/subcontractor clause: we can accept the clarified subcontractor handling language with a minimal addition referencing our standard third-party controls.
• 12-month audit logs: we will make the 12-month retention explicit in the Marketplace listing footnote for Dedicated and Private offers; for Hosted we'll state "configurable retention up to 12 months" and include onboarding steps to request export of logs.

I'm sending a DocuSign PO/terms packet to the email on file for the procurement team — link here: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/packet/ACME-PO-73. If procurement is happy with the small indemnity tweak, we can get a signed agreement and finalize the listing copy by EOD Wed (11/4).

Marissa — once signed can you slot a quick co-sell enablement note for the sellers (two bullets + objection responses)?

Thanks,
Jonas
Partner Sales — Redwood Inference
